481-in-the-bishop-s-carriage.title: In The Bishop'S Carriage
481-in-the-bishop-s-carriage.creator: Miriam Michelson
481-in-the-bishop-s-carriage.description: A book by Miriam Michelson. "Nance," I said under my breath, to the alert-eyed, pug-nosed girl in the mirror, who gave a quick glance about the room as I bent to wash my hands, "women stare 'cause they're women. There's no meaning in their look. If they were men, now, you might twitter."

arxiv-2012-07213.title: Subgroups of Classical Groups that are Transitive on Subspaces Thanks: The authors gratefully acknowledge the support of the Australian Research Council (ARC) Discovery Project Grants DP160102323 and DP190100450.
arxiv-2012-07213.creator: Michael Giudici, S. P. Glasby and Cheryl E. Praeger
arxiv-2012-07213.description: Abstract . For each finite classical group G G , we classify the subgroups of G G which act transitively on a G G -invariant set of subspaces of the natural module, where the subspaces are either totally isotropic or nondegenerate. Our proof uses the classification of the maximal factorisations of almost simple groups.

arxiv-2108-01325.title: The signless Laplacian state transfer in 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} -graph
arxiv-2108-01325.creator: Xiao-Qin Zhang, Shu-Yu Cui, Gui-Xian Tian
arxiv-2108-01325.description: Abstract The 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} -graph of a graph G G , denoted by 𝒬 ⁡ ( G ) \mathcal{Q}(G) , is the graph derived from G G by plugging a new vertex to each edge of G G and adding a new edge between two new vertices which lie on adjacent edges of G G .

arxiv-2203-08227.title: Sex Trouble: Common pitfalls in incorporating sex/gender in medical machine learning and how to avoid them
arxiv-2203-08227.creator: Kendra Albert*, Maggie Delano*
arxiv-2203-08227.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Kendra Albert*, Maggie Delano*. False assumptions about sex and gender are deeply embedded in the medical system, including that they are binary, static, and concordant. Machine learning researchers must understand the nature of these assumptions in order to avoid perpetuating them.

arxiv-2207-02302.title: Exact finite-dimensional reduction for a population of noisy oscillators and its link to Ott-Antonsen and Watanabe-Strogatz theories
arxiv-2207-02302.creator: Rok Cestnik, Arkady Pikovsky
arxiv-2207-02302.description: Abstract Populations of globally coupled phase oscillators are described in the thermodynamic limit by kinetic equations for the distribution densities, or equivalently, by infinite hierarchies of equations for the order parameters. Ott and Antonsen [Chaos 18, 037113 (2008)] have found an invariant finite-dimensional subspace on which the dynamics is described by one complex variable per population.

arxiv-2306-12527.title: The stable Picard group of finite Adams Hopf algebroids with an application to the ℝ \mathbb{R} -motivic Steenrod subalgebra 𝒜 ⁡ ( 1 ) ℝ \operatorname{\mathcal{A}}(1)^{\mathbb{R}}
arxiv-2306-12527.creator: Xu Gao, Ang Li
arxiv-2306-12527.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xu Gao, Ang Li. In this paper, we investigate the rigidity of the stable comodule category of a specific class of Hopf algebroids known as finite Adams , shedding light on its Picard group. Then we establish a reduction process through base changes, enabling us to effectively compute the Picard group of the ℝ \mathbb{R} -motivic mod 2 2 Steenrod subalgebra 𝒜 ⁡ ( 1 ) ℝ \operatorname{\mathcal{A}}(1)^{\mathbb{R}} .

arxiv-2306-13595.title: Autoencoders for Real-Time SUEP Detection
arxiv-2306-13595.creator: Simranjit Singh Chhibra, Nadezda Chernyavskaya, Benedikt Maier, Maurzio Pierini, Syed Hasan
arxiv-2306-13595.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Simranjit Singh Chhibra, Nadezda Chernyavskaya, Benedikt Maier, Maurzio Pierini, Syed Hasan. Confining dark sectors with pseudo-conformal dynamics can produce Soft Unclustered Energy Patterns (SUEP), at the Large Hadron Collider: the production of dark quarks in proton-proton collisions leading to a dark shower and the high-multiplicity production of dark hadrons. The final experimental signature is spherically-symmetric energy deposits by an anomalously large number of soft Standard Model particles with a transverse energy of 𝒪 ⁡ ( 10 2 ) ​ MeV \mathcal{O}(10^{2})\,\text{Me\hskip-0.80002ptV} .

arxiv-2405-20016.title: On the Random Minimum Spanning Subgraph Problem for Hypergraphs
arxiv-2405-20016.description: Abstract The weight of the minimum spanning tree in a complete weighted graph with random edge weights is a well-known problem. For various classes of distributions, it is proved that the weight of the minimum spanning tree tends to a constant, which can be calculated depending on the distribution. In this paper, we generalise this result to the hypergraphs setting.

arxiv-2409-18778.title: HardCore Generation: Generating Hard UNSAT Problems for Data Augmentation
arxiv-2409-18778.creator: Joseph Cotnareanu, Zhanguang Zhang, Hui-Ling Zhen, Yingxue Zhang, Mark Coates
arxiv-2409-18778.description: Abstract Efficiently determining the satisfiability of a boolean equation — known as the SAT problem for brevity — is crucial in various industrial problems. Recently, the advent of deep learning methods has introduced significant potential for enhancing SAT solving. However, a major barrier to the advancement of this field has been the scarcity of large, realistic datasets.

arxiv-2412-01888.title: The Millennium and Astrid galaxies in effective field theory: comparison with galaxy-halo connection models at the field level
arxiv-2412-01888.creator: Mikhail M. Ivanov, Carolina Cuesta-Lazaro, Andrej Obuljen, Michael W. Toomey, Yueying Ni, Sownak Bose, Boryana Hadzhiyska, César Hernández-Aguayo, Lars Hernquist, Rahul Kannan, Volker Springel
arxiv-2412-01888.description: Abstract Cosmological analyses of redshift space clustering data are primarily based on using luminous “red” galaxies (LRGs) and “blue” emission line galaxies (ELGs) to trace underlying dark matter. Using the large high-fidelity high-resolution MillenniumTNG (MTNG) and Astrid simulations, we study these galaxies with the effective field theory (EFT)-based field level forward model.

arxiv-2502-02461.title: An extended Wigner’s friend no-go theorem inspired by generalized contextuality
arxiv-2502-02461.creator: Laurens Walleghem, Lorenzo Catani
arxiv-2502-02461.description: Abstract The renowned Local Friendliness no-go theorem demonstrates the incompatibility of quantum theory with the combined assumptions of Absoluteness of Observed Events – the idea that observed outcomes are singular and objective – and Local Agency – the requirement that the only events correlated with a setting choice are in its future light cone.

arxiv-2503-23788.title: Detection of an extraterrestrial technical civilisation on the extrasolar planet GJ 1132 b
arxiv-2503-23788.creator: Frederic V. Hessman, Andrew Collier Cameron, Keith Horne
arxiv-2503-23788.description: Abstract We report the detection of whisky in the atmosphere of the extrasolar super-Earth planet GJ 1132 b from transmission spectroscopic data. It is seen both in atmospheric absorption as well as in chromospheric emission, the latter probably due to the intense heating of the co-rotating planet’s day-side surface.

arxiv-2602-05135.title: Growth of High-Redshift Quasars from Fermion Dark Matter Seeds
arxiv-2602-05135.creator: Yu Wang, Remo Ruffini
arxiv-2602-05135.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Yu Wang, Remo Ruffini. Quasars hosting ≳ 10 9 ​ M ⊙ \gtrsim 10^{9}\,M_{\odot} black holes at z > 6 z>6 challenge growth scenarios that start from light seeds and assume accretion within already formed galaxies. Motivated by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) discovery of Little Red Dots (LRDs), which suggests that ∼ 10 6 ​ M ⊙ \sim 10^{6}\,M_{\odot} black holes can be active in compact, pre-galactic environments, we revisit early black hole growth with a minimal cosmology-based framework.

arxiv-2605-18826.title: The Routing and Filtering Structure of Attention
arxiv-2605-18826.creator: Shafayeth Jamil, Rehan Kapadia

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-marquis-de-po.creator: Edgar Prestage
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-marquis-de-po.description: Article 'Marquis de Pombal' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-10623788.title: Enhancing powdery mildew resistance in soybean by targeted mutation of MLO genes using the CRISPR/Cas9 system
pmc-10623788.creator: Thao Phuong Bui, Huy Le, Dong Thi Ta, Cuong Xuan Nguyen, Ngoc Thu Le, Truong Thi Tran, Phuong Van Nguyen, Gary Stacey, Minviluz G. Stacey, Ngoc Bich Pham, Ha Hoang Chu, Phat Tien Do
pmc-10623788.description: BackgroundPowdery mildew is a major disease that causes great losses in soybean yield and seed quality. Disease-resistant varieties, which are generated by reducing the impact of susceptibility genes through mutation in host plants, would be an effective approach to protect crops from this disease. The Mildew Locus O (MLO) genes are well-known susceptibility genes for powdery mildew in plant.

pmc-10626772.title: Experiences of rehabilitation in young elite athletes: an interview study
pmc-10626772.creator: Linda Ekenros, Cecilia Fridén, Philip von Rosen
pmc-10626772.description: Even though injuries are common in elite youth sports, rehabilitation experiences are limited explored in young athletes. This study explored rehabilitation experiences in athletes with a previous injury studying at sports high schools. Twenty-six (14/12 females/males) young elite athletes (age 15–19 years) from 11 individual/team sports were interviewed in focus groups about the rehabilitation experiences following a sports injury.

pmc-10723196.title: Malnutrition in Allergic Bronchopulmonary Aspergillosis complicating asthma
pmc-10723196.creator: Venkateshan Madhavan, Valliappan Muthu, Inderpaul Singh Sehgal, Sahajal Dhooria, Kuruswamy Thurai Prasad, Ashutosh Nath Aggarwal, Ritesh Agarwal
pmc-10723196.description: tate. We have previously observed the body weight of asthmatic subjects with ABPA lower than those without ABPA.[2] However, body weight may not accurately reflect a loss in muscle mass[3] and can be preserved till late, especially among subjects on systemic glucocorticoids (e.g., ABPA) or obese individuals.[4] Therefore, other nutritional indices should be assessed.

pmc-11472419.title: Successful strategies for preventing and controlling violence against people with intellectual disabilities: a scoping review
pmc-11472419.creator: Mariana Teixeira da Silva, Paula Hino, Meiry Fernanda Pinto Okuno, Mônica Taminato, Dulce Aparecida Barbosa, Hugo Fernandes
pmc-11472419.description: BackgroundViolence against people with intellectual disabilities is unfortunately a reality all over the world, as they are one of the populations most vulnerable to various forms of aggression. Assertive prevention and control measures are crucial to tackle and reduce this problem.

pmc-11505560.title: A Novel Bifidobacterium longum Subsp. longum T1 Strain from Cow’s Milk: Homeostatic and Antibacterial Activity against ESBL-Producing Escherichia coli
pmc-11505560.creator: Andrey V Machulin, Vyacheslav M Abramov, Igor V Kosarev, Evgenia I Deryusheva, Tatiana V Priputnevich, Alexander N Panin, Ashot M Manoyan, Irina O Chikileva, Tatiana N Abashina, Dmitriy A Blumenkrants, Olga E Ivanova, Tigran T Papazyan, Ilia N Nikonov, Nataliya E Suzina, Vyacheslav G Melnikov, Valen
pmc-11505560.description: Background/Objectives: The global emergence of antibiotic-resistant zooanthroponotic Escherichia coli strains, producing extended-spectrum beta-lactamases (ESBL-E) and persisting in the intestines of farm animals, has now led to the development of a pandemic of extra-intestinal infectious diseases in humans. The search for innovative probiotic microorganisms that eliminate ESBL-E from the intestines of humans and animals is relevant.

pmc-11539141.title: Psychological hardiness, social support, and emotional labor among nurses in Iran during the COVID-19 pandemic: A cross-sectional survey study
pmc-11539141.creator: Elham SAEI, Raymond T LEE
pmc-11539141.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundOur study of nurses in Tehran was conducted in June of 2020, when the lockdown from the pandemic had been implemented. Nurses had been faced with how to effectively manage their own emotion responses during patientcare.ObjectivesOur study aims to evaluate how psychological and social resources were jointly related to the use of emotional labor through surface acting and deep acting among nurses at public hospitals.DesignThe study design was a single-wave, cross-sectional self-report questionnaire survey containing validated measures where the nurses reported on

pmc-11556641.title: Informing community pharmacists on COPD case-finding methods: A scoping review
pmc-11556641.creator: Omowumi Idowu, Meghan Sebastianski, Janice Y Kung, Nese Yuksel, Theresa J Schindel, Ross T Tsuyuki, Randy So, Tatiana Makhinova
pmc-11556641.description: Background:Early detection of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a strategy to address the increasing human and economic costs of this condition. This study aimed to inform pharmacists’ case-finding strategies by providing an overview of case-finding approaches by health care practitioners.

pmc-11716478.title: White matter aging in late midlife women: Validation and association with neurodegenerative biomarkers
pmc-11716478.creator: Jinghang Li, Minjie Wu, Chang‐Le Chen, Linghai Wang, Shaolin Yang, Howard J Aizenstein, Yuefang Chang, Thomas K Karikari, Carol A. Derby, Pauline M Maki, Rebecca C Thurston
pmc-11716478.description: BackgroundBrain age (BA) prediction models have emerged as valuable tools for understanding individual differences in trajectories of brain aging. These models aim to estimate overall brain health by predicting BA based on structural MRI data. To enhance the specificity of existing BA models, we introduce a deep learning‐based BA prediction model.

pmc-12390174.title: Biosynthetic Collagen-Analog Hydrogels Stimulate Endogenous Regrowth of Rabbit Corneas: A Pilot Study
pmc-12390174.creator: Iris Timmerman, Marie-Claude Robert, Claire Vergneau-Grosset, Tristan Juette, Javier Benito, Marta Garbin, Mostafa Zamani-Roudbaraki, Mona Moradi, Hamid Goodarzi, Christos Boutopoulos, Marie-Odile Benoit-Biancamano, May Griffith, Maria Vanore, Mark L Weiss
pmc-12390174.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryPreserving visual function and ocular integrity in the presence of corneal disease remains challenging due to the limitations of existing methods. The materials currently in use present several drawbacks, including reduced transparency, uncertain availability, and high complication rates. In veterinary medicine, corneal grafting in companion animals is further complicated by the limited availability of high-quality allografts, which remain the gold standard for corneal transplantation.

pmc-12528294.title: Ginsenoside Rh2 targets SIRT1-mediated deacetylation to modulate ERα/AR balance and overcome endocrine therapy resistance in prostate cancer using 3D organoid models
pmc-12528294.creator: Xinan Chen, Wei Luo, Yueying Ren, Zezhong Mou, Chenyang Xu, Jimeng Hu, Mengbo Hu, Haowen Jiang
pmc-12528294.description: Resistance to endocrine therapy remains a major challenge in treating prostate cancer (PCa), highlighting the need for alternative therapeutic approaches. In this study, we investigated the potential of Ginsenoside Rh2 to counteract such resistance by influencing the SIRT1-dependent deacetylation pathway, thereby modulating the equilibrium between estrogen receptor α (ERα) and androgen receptor (AR).

pmc-12542175.title: Obstructive sleep apnea and the risk of sudden cardiac death: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12542175.creator: Xiaorong Zou, Xiong Zhou, Song Yi
pmc-12542175.description: BackgroundObstructive sleep apnea (OSA) has been linked to adverse cardiovascular outcomes, but its role as a risk factor for sudden cardiac death (SCD) remains uncertain. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the association between OSA and SCD and assess the influence of disease severity and treatment.

pmc-12683757.title: Impact of Antibiotic Exposure on Pediatric Drug Eruption: A Nationwide Cohort Study in Korea
pmc-12683757.creator: Soo Min Jeon, Junwoo Jo, Juhee Ryu, Jin-Won Kwon, Jiung Jeong
pmc-12683757.description: PurposeAntibiotic-related drug eruption is a common cutaneous adverse reaction in pediatric populations. However, its incidence and risk factor remain unclear. This study investigated the incidence of drug eruptions in pediatrics and its association with antibiotic exposure to identify potential risk factors.

pmc-12827331.title: Ultra-rapid preparation of large-area high-crystallinity covalent organic framework membranes
pmc-12827331.creator: Yan Pan, Gangqiang Yu, Luteng Gao, Xueyong Li, Lan Yang, Haiqi Gao, Tianfu Wang, Wenhai Zhang, Shengqian Ma, Hong Meng
pmc-12827331.description: It has been challenging to rapidly prepare high-crystallinity covalent organic framework (COF) membranes particularly in large areas because their crystallization often requires extensive time spent on trial and error and screening. Here, we have developed a reverse-phase microemulsion interfacial polymerization to ultra-rapidly prepare COF membranes in tens of seconds.

pmc-12997627.title: Multimodal imaging in retinitis pigmentosa related to the EYS gene
pmc-12997627.creator: Ester Abigail da Silva Martins, Gabriela Doná Rodrigues, Kendy Junior Ivama, Mariana Costa Pereira, Caio Henrique Marques Texeira, Rebeca Azevedo Souza Amaral, Juliana Maria Ferraz Sallum
pmc-12997627.description: PurposeThis study aimed to characterize retinitis pigmentosa associated with the eyes shut homolog gene, which causes hereditary retinal degeneration.MethodsThe anatomical and functional findings of retinitis pigmentosa in patients with variants of the eyes shut homolog gene were characterized and compared using multimodal imaging and genetic analysis of the variants.

pmc-13080791.title: Case Report: Prostate adenocarcinoma with peritoneal carcinomatosis and elevated CEA mimicking colorectal cancer: a diagnostic dilemma
pmc-13080791.creator: Hala Majeed, Nathan Shelman, Jitesh A. Patel, Janeesh S. Veedu, Insija I. Selene, Ashlyn Whitesell, Zin W. Myint
pmc-13080791.description: This case report describes an exceptionally rare manifestation of prostate adenocarcinoma presenting with peritoneal carcinomatosis, rectal obstruction, and markedly elevated carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA), closely mimicking colorectal cancer. A 65-year-old man with localized high-grade prostate adenocarcinoma (Gleason 4 + 4) underwent robotic prostatectomy in November 2020, followed by salvage radiation and stereotactic body radiation therapy for early biochemical recurrence.

pmc-13106505.title: Pink1 at the crossroads of aging, exercise, and diet in Parkinson’s disease: a mechanistic review
pmc-13106505.creator: Ying Lin, Deng-tai Wen
pmc-13106505.description: Pink1 (PTEN-induced kinase 1) is a key guardian of mitochondrial quality via mitophagy; its mutations are tightly linked to early-onset PD. This review synthesizes how aging, exercise, and high-fat diet (HFD) modulate Pink1 activity and thereby PD risk. Aging down-regulates Pink1, impairing clearance of damaged mitochondria and promoting α-synuclein aggregation.

pmc-13263682.title: NGS-based measurable residual disease in long-term progression-free CLL survivors following FCR therapy∗
pmc-13263682.creator: Alexandre Bazinet, Alessandra Ferrajoli, Nitin Jain, Jan Burger, Musa Yilmaz, Mahesh Swaminathan, Hagop Kantarjian, Michael Keating, Philip A Thompson, William G Wierda
pmc-13263682.description: L).1 In a recently updated analysis from the original 300-patient FCR study, we observed a plateau in progression-free survival (PFS) in the subgroup of patients with mutated immunoglobulin heavy chain variable region (IGHV) gene with 19 years of median follow-up despite CLL being traditionally considered an “incurable” disease with CIT.

pmc-13360147.title: Correlation Between Breath Acetone and Ketone Bodies in Blood and Urine Among Individuals with Different Glycometabolic Statuses Based on PTR-TOF-MS
pmc-13360147.creator: Ting Li, Yanting Yang, Chen Huang, Hanlu Yue, Li Chen, Yan Huang, Fengming Luo

pmc-13421358.title: Patterns of patient worry following major emergency abdominal surgery: a 180-day follow-up study
pmc-13421358.creator: Malthe Kirk Parner, Lasse Rehné Jensen, Hejdi Gamst-Jensen, Jakob Burcharth, Dunja Kokotovic

pmc-13616923.title: Maraviroc attenuates inflammation-exacerbated cognitive and amyloid pathology in an early-stage Alzheimer’s disease mouse model
pmc-13616923.creator: Chang Liu, Ting Zhang, Er-Deng E, Tian-Yang Xu, Fei-Ran Yang, Jia-Wen Li, Qing Shang, Zhong-Yu Zhang, Hao-Wei Shen, Xiao-Qin Zhang
pmc-13616923.description: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is an age-related neurodegenerative disorder characterized by progressive cognitive decline, and increasing evidence indicates that systemic inflammation can accelerate disease progression. Maraviroc, a CCR5 antagonist approved for the treatment of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection, has shown neuroprotective effects in several neurological contexts, but its role in AD-related pathology remains unclear.

pmc-13630758.title: A rare case of gastroenteritis due to salmonella enterica serovar Infantis in South India
pmc-13630758.creator: S. C. Shruthi Shree, Yogeesh D. Maheshwarappa, Mahadevaiah Neelambike Sumana, Deepashree Rajshekar, Supreeta R. Shettar, G. K. Megha, Veerabhadraswamy G. S., Chinchana Shylaja Eshwarappa, Morubagal Raghavendra Rao, Vidhyavathi B. Chitharagi
pmc-13630758.description: Salmonella enterica serovar Infantis is an emerging non-typhoidal Salmonella (NTS) serovar increasingly associated with foodborne gastroenteritis. Human infections caused by this serovar remain underreported in India. We report a case of acute gastroenteritis caused by Salmonella enterica serovar Infantis in a 53-year-old male from South India.
